title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Tensionless String Limits in 4d SCFTs
summary: We study the appearance of universality classes in overall weak-coupling infinite-distance limits in the conformal manifold of 4d ${\cal N}=4,2,1$ superconformal gauge theories at large $N$ and their relation to the type of weakly-coupled emergent string in the AdS bulk dual using brane models. We focus on the complete set of theories with simple gauge group, and provide explicit Hanany-Witten constructions for each of them, including those that have non-Einstein bulk duals.
